messages:
ashley chen: Heads up — scheduled Trivy run started failing at ~04:12 UTC with KMS decrypt errors and we're seeing suppressed CVEs reappear in alerts. Anyone seeing the same?

kevin r.: Yep, saw the `KMS.DecryptAccessDenied` in the collector logs. Looks like decrypt is failing for the scanner service account.

sec-bot: [scan-orchestrator] job=scan-20260320-0412 status=failed error=KMS.DecryptAccessDenied logs=https://logs.redwood.internal/scan-20260320-0412

lia (sec): If KMS denies, suppression validation can't run -> suppression list fallback is empty which causes re-alerts. Do we know recent KMS RBAC changes?

mike_j: I pushed a small IAM tweak in infra PR #342 yesterday to tighten alias use. Possible it removed the old alias from the binding. Rolling back to confirm.

ashley chen: Workaround thought — we can pause suppression enforcement for backfills until CI confirms fix, but we'd prefer not to. Logging audit id 9f8c for triage.

kevin r.: Also seeing GHAS runners retrying webhooks which led to duplicate Snyk alerts in some repos around the same time. Might be two issues coinciding.

lia (sec): Proposed plan: 1) verify IAM bindings and rollback PR if needed; 2) add short-lived cache of suppressions in orchestrator (1h) to tolerate KMS hiccups; 3) run a controlled backfill after fix.

mike_j: Opening rollback + binding-fix PR now. Will also add a small cache/ttl change to the scanner config. ETA ~30–120m depending on CI.

ashley chen: :thumbsup: I'll freeze triage for any new CVEs from the automated pipeline until suppression state confirmed. Please add any affected CVEs to the incident tracker (INC-2026-078).

sec-bot: Incident created INC-2026-078: scanner-kms-decrypt -> https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2026-078

lia (sec): Noted missing decrypt audit entries for a few attempts — checking CloudKMS admin logs to map which service account was used. If alias changed earlier, audit may point to the alias creation time.

kevin r.: Repro nailed down: consul-template rotated the KMS key alias yesterday; new alias wasn't added to the scanner IAM binding. Local repro decrypt fails with same error.

mike_j: Fix PR posted: add alias to scanner role binding + add TTLed suppression cache fallback. Running CI now.

ashley chen: After deploy, run `./scripts/scan-backfill --since=24h` and monitor dedup logic. I'll verify alerts and mark incident status.

lia (sec): After fix, we should also add an integration test that simulates KMS permission denial and confirms suppression cache fallback works (no noisy alerts).

kevin r.: Agreed. I'll add a test to the scanner integration suite.

mike_j: Deploy looks green on staging. Rolling to prod in 15m.

ashley chen: Thanks everyone — ping here when prod is green and we can close the incident.

sec-bot: [update] INC-2026-078 status=monitoring assigned=mike_j,lia (sec) links=[https://deploys.redwood/internal/roll/5678]
